cohort: 2438 neonates (1071 born by low-risk planned Caesarian delivery and 1367 born through planned NVD)
finding: Neonates born by low-risk planned Caesarian delivery and planned normal vaginal delivery had similar early and late outcomes up to 2 years of age.
birth_weight: Caesarian delivery group: 3166 (±442.4) grams, NVD group: 3213 (±454.8) grams
